chunks: 1776 - And he, peace be upon him, said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"And seek help through patience and prayer."
He said: "What is meant by patience is fasting."

key_terms.الصَّبْرِ: patience; here interpreted specifically as fasting
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), a means of seeking divine help
key_terms.الصَّوْمَ: fasting, the intended meaning of patience in this verse
key_terms.قَوْلِ: the saying or statement, referring here to the Qur'anic verse

ai.seo_question: What does "patience" mean in the verse "And seek help through patience and prayer"?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains the Qur'anic phrase about seeking help through patience and prayer by interpreting patience here as fasting. This shows fasting as a means of spiritual aid and steadfastness alongside salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1776 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty:
"And seek help through patience and prayer"

(Surah Al-Baqarah 2:45):
(Imam (as) said) "By patience, it means fasting."
